Manifesto.label: What is StayLooped?
Manifesto.body: StayLooped isn't one person's opinion. It's a living guide built by the people who actually live here — hosts, long-term expats, local chefs, guides, and residents. Every recommendation is a "Loop" — a real endorsement from a real person with their name on it.
Manifesto.bodyExtra: No algorithms. No paid placements. No fake reviews.

Footer.tagline: Recommended by people who actually live here.
Footer.smallPrint: Small commissions on bookings keep this guide free and independent. We only loop things we'd genuinely recommend to a friend.
